title: Real Numbers
desc: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, Euclid division lemmas, HCF & LCM identities, prime factorisation rules, and irrationality proofs (√2, √3, √5).

title: Polynomials
desc: Standard quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c, relations between zeroes and coefficients (α + β = -b/a, αβ = c/a), cubic relations, and graphs.

title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
desc: Consistency criteria (a1/a2 vs b1/b2 vs c1/c2), graphical representation rules, substitution, elimination, and reducible linear equations.

title: Quadratic Equations
desc: Quadratic formula x = (-b ± √D) / 2a, discriminant D = b² - 4ac, nature of roots conditions, and factorization shortcut methods.

title: Arithmetic Progressions
desc: General term an = a + (n-1)d, sum of n terms Sn = n/2[2a + (n-1)d] = n/2(a + l), selection of terms, and arithmetic mean.

title: Triangles
desc: Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales), converse of BPT, criteria for similarity of triangles (AAA, SSS, SAS), and ratio of areas.

title: Coordinate Geometry
desc: Distance formula d = √[(x2-x1)² + (y2-y1)²], section formula (internal division), midpoint coordinates, and centroid of a triangle.

title: Introduction to Trigonometry
desc: Trigonometric ratios (sin, cos, tan, cot, sec, cosec), specific angle table (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°), and fundamental Pythagorean identities.

title: Some Applications of Trigonometry
desc: Line of sight, angle of elevation, angle of depression, standard two-triangle height and distance cases, and speed-distance applications.

title: Circles
desc: Tangent to a circle properties, radius is perpendicular to tangent at point of contact, and lengths of tangents from an external point are equal.

title: Areas Related to Circles
desc: Circumference 2πr, area πr², length of arc (θ/360)×2πr, area of sector (θ/360)×πr², area of major/minor segments, and combination figures.

title: Surface Areas and Volumes
desc: Formulas for cube, cuboid, right circular cylinder, cone, sphere, hemisphere (CSA, TSA, Volume), and combination solids.

title: Statistics
desc: Mean for grouped data (Direct, Assumed Mean methods), Mode formula, Median formula, modal class, median class, and 3Median = Mode + 2Mean.

title: Probability
desc: Theoretical probability P(E) = n(E)/n(S), 0 ≤ P(E) ≤ 1, complementary event P(E') = 1 - P(E), coin tosses, pairs of dice, and pack of 52 cards.
